SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-06-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO FEB-07-2022 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT.506. PLAINTIFF XAVIER BLAKE IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT CLARE O'HOYNE IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT ELIZABETH CONNELL IS PRESENT. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $1,080.00 (WHICH INCLUDES COSTS) TO THE PLAINTIFF. TWO PAYMENTS OF $540.00 WILL BE MAILED TO THE PLAINTIFF. FIRST PAYMENT OF $540.00 WILL BE MAILED TODAY AND SECOND PAYMENT OF $540.00 WILL BE MAILED A MONTH FROM TODAY. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE FEB-07-2022 HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. DEFENDANT ELIZABETH CONNELL DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: A. DATT. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
